description_expanded: Nothing but vacation bliss at Twente Toes, a gorgeous home located in the quiet private community of Villages of Navarre! With a community pool, beach and dock access to the Navarre Sound, and more, enjoy sun-filled days swimming, fishing, kayaking, and more in beautiful Navarre! Beyond location, there’s so much to love in this 3-story retreat with room to roam! Spacious rooms filled with cozy furnishings welcome groups of all sizes eager to enjoy the beautiful surroundings, whether in the open-concept living/dining area, in comfortable bedrooms, or on the private balcony. If you have littles, they’ll love playing in the calm waters of the Santa Rosa Sound, and the beach is just a five-minute walk away! Twente Toes is within just a few miles of several popular restaurants, including Juana’s Pagodas, The Slippery Mermaid Sushi Bar, Samurai Japanese Steakhouse, Dewey Destin’s, and Johnny Huston’s Grille and Bar. Nearby family-friendly attractions include the Gulf Breeze Zoo, Navarre Beach Fishing Pier, Sea Turtle Conservation Center, and Navarre Family Water Sports Adventure Complex. *Parking - The garage area will hold 2 vehicles, with room for  4 in the driveway.  PER HOA RULES:  Vehicles are not permitted on the street, including but not limited to boats, trailers, RVs, and jet skis.  For your convenience, a public parking area is located along the main road of Gulf Blvd. for parking these items. **As this home resides in a private community with permanent residents, guests should abide by community rules, including parking, noise, trash, pool use, etc. Book your stay at this Scenic Stays property today and create lasting memories in this coastal paradise. Parties, events, bachelor and bachelorette parties are strictly prohibited, and an adult chaperone must accompany guests under 25 throughout their stay. Smoking is strictly forbidden, and pets are unfortunately not welcome and subject to immediate departure if found to be inhabiting a property. Guests found in violation are subject to eviction with no refund. POOL GATE CODE:34215   POOL BATHROOM CODE: 0342#  DOCK CODE 001421#
